route.name: The Hidden Halls, Brass Nights & Moonshot Run
route.direction: Boston to Houston through New Haven, Philadelphia, Baltimore, the Shenandoah Valley, Asheville, Atlanta, Montgomery, the Gulf Coast, New Orleans and Cajun Country
route.summary: A bold one-way trip from Boston to Houston with 28 main stops. Every hidden gem is now part of the real plan: secret libraries, caves, fossils, Gulf folk art, giant parade floats, a quiet swamp, moon rockets and an underground world of 220 columns.

constraints.visa_policy: US-only; no Canada crossing or J-1 re-entry dependency.
constraints.end_state_assumption: Return both cars in Houston and fly or continue from Texas on October 15. This route does not return to Boston.
